narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The square works the same way, with every side three centimetres.
<bookmark mark='lift'/>Lift out one corner of the square. It is a right triangle, with legs of three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The slanted cut is across the right angle, so it must be longer than each leg.
